answer: Tie every new identity's registration stake to its funding anchor — the on-chain source that bankrolled it — and make that stake grow quadratically with each sibling already traced to the same anchor. One honest agent rests at the base; a sybil ring sharing a purse must climb a brutal capital summit, each fake costlier than the last. Costs spiral super-linearly, so forging N identities demands N genuinely independent, unrelated funding roots, not one wallet wearing many masks.
